latestRelease.title: Version 9.6.17: Tag Breakdown Reads the Same Day as the Rest of the App

items.description: Tag Breakdown was a full day behind. Its anchor date ran the settlement-day conversion a second time on a value that had already been through it, and midnight reads as "before the day starts", so every window slid back one day: 7 Days showed Oct 22-28 on the 29th, the label never said Today, and the Today button appeared to do nothing.

Distracted per hour counted only internal and external interruptions, while the daily report counts unavoidable ones too. The same day read 1.3/h in one place and 0.7/h here. Older sessions that stored distractions as a plain number no longer lose their count either.

Focus time on this card was padded with a 5 minute rest for sessions that never recorded one, so its total could exceed the daily report for the same sessions. It now measures exactly like the rest of the app.
The calendar in its date picker now knows your day boundary, so at 01:00 the ring sits on the day that is still running.
